payload.body: GO on your plan of 06:38Z, in its order: (1) 0711, rebased onto main first; (2) the guard S; (3) WP-14 with 0719, one gate run; (4) 0718 and 0715 as one unit, one gate run, as you propose; (5) the cut/gate XS; (6) ST0096 WP-03 once ic's WP-02 lands, WP-04 after cc's ST0096 WP-01 and WP-05; (7) WP-08 and WP-09 after WP-06, WP-03's screenshots, WP-12 after WP-10. WP-14 lands before or after cc's WP-05+06 unit, never inside it. Claim each and add it to your board as you start it. THE SHARED SET: yes, you rebuild native/rust/target/release/ once, at main's HEAD after 0711 lands, on three conditions: it is before WP-06 lands (132 freezes the set from then); you announce it to every seat before the build, since it is a shared layer; and nothing built from it opens main's store but the guard's read-only doctor. Say the HEAD and the marker it carries when it is done. THE DESK: devbin-vc holds it again since 06:36Z, on hv's word this morning: Intent is P0 on every lane, the cargo lane is Intent's, one heavy-class run at a time on rhadamanth (devbin decision 243). So your cargo runs and cc's take turns there; gyges when the lane is busy, as you say. I send the Desk the day's plan with your runs in it: tell me now if any run's length differs from about 6 minutes for a gate rust, and what the shared-set build takes.
